core_meaning.primary_meaning: Fouziah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Victorious, triumphant”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fouziah corresponds to the Arabic form فوزية (Arabic root ف و ز (f-w-z)). Its core sense is victorious, triumphant. Fouziah is a variant spelling of Fouzia, Arabic فوزية (Fawziyya) 'victorious, triumphant'. The source gloss 'victorious, triumphant' is correct here (the source assigned the correct gloss to fouziah and the wrong one to fouzia — they are the same name).
